# derivation target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:derivationTarget`](gmeow-derivationTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The descendant lexical item or form that is derived from the source. Functional per relator: one target per [`EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) -> [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:derivationTarget`](gmeow-derivationTarget.md) from [`gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) to [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/lexicon/examples/word-etymology.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/lexicon/examples/word-etymology.ttl)

```turtle
# --- The etymology: a typed derivation (borrowing) from Greek into English.
ex:etymology a gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation ;
    gmeow:derivationSource ex:greekOntos ;
    gmeow:derivationTarget ex:ontology ;
    gmeow:derivationKind   gmeow:derivationBorrowing .
```

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on an [`EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) to name the single descendant lexical item or form derived from the source.

### Avoid when

- Avoid naming more than one target (it is functional) and avoid swapping it with [`gmeow:derivationSource`](gmeow-derivationSource.md) — the target is the descendant, the source the ancestor.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:derivationTarget`](gmeow-derivationTarget.md) once from the relator to its descendant (required by the someValuesFrom axiom); it specializes [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) for generic observation queries.

### Examples

- ex:etym1 [`gmeow:derivationTarget`](gmeow-derivationTarget.md) ex:wordWater.
